dedupe_keys.name: energy consumption dataset for smart homes

description: Energy Consumption Dataset For Smart Homes is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors rabie ramadan. This is a generated data for smart homes energy consumption and production. the data generated for 20, 50, 100 and 200 homes. Also, there is a dataset for 50 homes that is based on north Saudi Arabia weather. the data includes the energy production and energy consumption as well as the transactions. Coverage: national (SA); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
